{"rules": ["Model exhibits severe underestimation during high-volatility regimes; true outcomes often spike 5-10% above forecasts within the first 7 days.", "Sentiment history shows a lag of ~3 days relative to price action; positive sentiment spikes (0.50) consistently precede major upward corrections by 2-4 days.", "Model fails to capture mean reversion after sharp rallies, producing flat or slowly rising forecasts when true outcomes show significant volatility and reversal.", "Forecast horizon bias is present: early forecast points are systematically lower than actuals, while later points may overestimate if the initial spike is not fully accounted for in the trend.", "When recent history shows a downward trend followed by a sentiment shift, the model's flat trajectory creates a large negative error until the true upward momentum materializes."]
